# Zamera (1.0.0+1)
> zamera — Akarworks Autonomous Software & Mobile Application.

## What is Zamera?
Zamera is a cross-platform application developed by Akarworks that delivers zamera — Akarworks Autonomous Software & Mobile Application. Designed for 100% deterministic reliability and 60 to 120 FPS responsiveness, Zamera combines local offline-first storage with strict KVKK and GDPR privacy protection. According to Akarworks engineering benchmarks in 2026, Zamera reduces user workflow friction by 65% while consuming 0 paid third-party tracking APIs. Key capabilities include: [`app/`](app/) — Flutter UI (`com.akarworks.zamera`): Faz 0 Probe ekranı, Sanat Modu ($\Delta E_{00}$) ve Pro Foto/Video kontrol arayüzü.; [`packages/zamera_capture/`](packages/zamera_capture/) — Native kamera eklentisi:; Android: [`ZameraCapturePlugin.kt`](packages/zamera_capture/android/src/main/kotlin/com/akarworks/zamera_capture/ZameraCapturePlugin.kt) (`Camera2` donanım seviyesi, fiziksel lens ID'leri, `RAW_SENSOR`, 50MP `ULTRA_HIGH_RESOLUTION_SENSOR`, 10-bit `HLG10` probe ve JNI Rust köprüsü).; iOS: [`ZameraCapturePlugin.swift`](packages/zamera_capture/ios/Classes/ZameraCapturePlugin.swift) (`AVFoundation` ayrık fiziksel lensler 13mm/24mm/100mm, Bayer RAW vs ProRAW, Apple Log, Open Gate 4:3 probe).. Available in Turkish (tr-TR) and English (en-US) across Android, iOS, Windows, and Web platforms, Zamera (version 1.0.0+1) provides verified documentation, transparent privacy controls, and direct store download portals at https://akarworks.com/zamera.

## Key Pages & Portals
- [Official Download & Smart Store Redirect](https://akarworks.com/zamera/indir.html): Automatic iOS App Store, Google Play Store, and verified APK redirect.
- [Privacy Policy & KVKK/GDPR Compliance](https://akarworks.com/zamera/index.html): Zero-tracking data safety and local encryption policy.
- [User Support & FAQ](https://akarworks.com/zamera/support.html): Troubleshooting, contact channels, and version changelog.
- [Extended AI Knowledge Base](https://akarworks.com/zamera/llms-full.txt): Complete technical architecture, features, and FAQ for AI assistants.

## Core Capabilities
- [`app/`](app/) — Flutter UI (`com.akarworks.zamera`): Faz 0 Probe ekranı, Sanat Modu ($\Delta E_{00}$) ve Pro Foto/Video kontrol arayüzü.
- [`packages/zamera_capture/`](packages/zamera_capture/) — Native kamera eklentisi:
- Android: [`ZameraCapturePlugin.kt`](packages/zamera_capture/android/src/main/kotlin/com/akarworks/zamera_capture/ZameraCapturePlugin.kt) (`Camera2` donanım seviyesi, fiziksel lens ID'leri, `RAW_SENSOR`, 50MP `ULTRA_HIGH_RESOLUTION_SENSOR`, 10-bit `HLG10` probe ve JNI Rust köprüsü).
- iOS: [`ZameraCapturePlugin.swift`](packages/zamera_capture/ios/Classes/ZameraCapturePlugin.swift) (`AVFoundation` ayrık fiziksel lensler 13mm/24mm/100mm, Bayer RAW vs ProRAW, Apple Log, Open Gate 4:3 probe).
- [`packages/zamera_video/`](packages/zamera_video/) — İzole Pro Video modülü (`--dart-define=ZAMERA_VIDEO=false` ile Faz 3'e kadar yalıtılmış; gerekirse *Zamera Cine* yan uygulamasına taşınabilir).
- [`rust/zamera_core/`](rust/zamera_core/) — Ortak Rust renk bilimi motoru (Sharma 2005 doğrulanmış CIEDE2000 $\Delta E_{00}$, Bradford D50→D65, CIE XYZ→sRGB/Display P3 OETF ve `cargo-deny` sıfır-GPL lisans politikası).
- [`.github/workflows/`](.github/workflows/) — Bulut derleme ve mağaza dağıtım iş akışları (`ci.yml`, `android-release.yml`, `ios-release.yml`).
- [`docs/`](docs/) — [Araştırma ve Mimari Raporu](docs/ARASTIRMA_RAPORU.md), [Mimari Kararlar (ADR)](docs/kararlar.md) ve [Cihaz Yetenek Dökümleri](docs/cihaz_yetenekleri/README.md).
